name: Hollow Victory
description: Every win costs you something. The victories pile up but so does the weight they carry.
effect: -2 Alacrity and -2 Wisdom at character creation.
ai_instruction: Subtract 2 from character Alacrity and 2 from character Wisdom during character creation. Narrate as the accumulated cost of survival — a mind that second-guesses, instincts dulled by the weight of past battles.
